chapter: On the road, Philadelphia and New York
title: From Cleveland to Detroit
summary: He left Cleveland for Detroit and was held over everywhere.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Before we were talking about playing in Cleveland. Where did you go from there.

Well, we stayed there so long, I just had to get out of there -- adventure -- but I didn't have no agents. So, I got hung up, too. We went to Detroit. We stayed out there a long time. Everywhere we went we were held over. Because we had a very good entertaining act.
